sections.title: Story
sections.note: Dungeons, pearls and the Master Sword, in story order.

items.name: Outset Island
items.howTo: On Link's birthday, get the Telescope from Aryll, the Hero's Sword from Orca and the Hero's Shield from Grandma, then cross the bridge to the forest and rescue Tetra.
items.notes: The Hero's Shield comes once Tetra's pirates agree to take Link to the Forsaken Fortress.

items.name: Forsaken Fortress (first visit)
items.howTo: Get the Spoils Bag from Niko's rope-swinging test on Tetra's ship, then be fired into the fortress. Sneak to the top tower without a sword, find your sword on the way up and reach Aryll before the Helmaroc King throws you out.
items.notes: Tetra slips Link the Pirate's Charm before launching him. The Piece of Heart in the jail cell is in Heart Pieces.

items.name: The Sail
items.howTo: The King of Red Lions brings Link to Windfall. Buy the Sail from Zunari for 80 Rupees.
items.notes: Wind Waker HD sells the Swift Sail at the Windfall Auction, which turns the wind for you and sails faster.

items.name: Dragon Roost Island
items.howTo: The King of Red Lions gives Link the Wind Waker on the way. Learn the Wind's Requiem at the stone tablet, get the Delivery Bag from Quill, talk to Komali and help Medli up the mountain, who gives Link a Bottle.
items.reward: Wind Waker, Wind's Requiem, Delivery Bag, Bottle

items.name: Dragon Roost Cavern
items.howTo: Climb Dragon Roost Island to the cavern, get the Grappling Hook from Medli and calm Valoo by defeating Gohma.
items.notes: Boss: Gohma. Treasure: Grappling Hook.

items.name: Din's Pearl
items.howTo: Komali gives it to Link once Valoo is calmed.

items.name: Forest Haven
items.howTo: Sail to Forest Haven, clear the ChuChus off the Deku Tree and climb the Baba Buds to the top for the Deku Leaf.

items.name: Forbidden Woods
items.howTo: Fly across from Forest Haven with the Deku Leaf, find the Boomerang and rescue Makar from Kalle Demos.
items.notes: Boss: Kalle Demos. Treasure: Boomerang.

items.name: Farore's Pearl
items.howTo: The Deku Tree gives it to Link after the Korok ceremony.

items.name: Bombs from Tetra's ship
items.howTo: Greatfish Isle has been wrecked. The King of Red Lions sends Link back to Windfall, where Tetra's pirates have stolen the Bomb Shop's stock: sneak aboard their ship, give Niko the password and pass his second test.
items.notes: Jabun's whereabouts come from Tetra here.

items.name: Nayru's Pearl
items.howTo: With Bombs, the King of Red Lions can fire its cannon: blow open the stone door to Jabun's cave at the back of Outset Island, and Jabun gives Link the pearl.

items.name: Tower of the Gods
items.howTo: Place the three pearls on the goddess statues of the Triangle Islands, sail into the ring of light, and climb the tower to Gohdan.
items.notes: Boss: Gohdan. Treasure: Hero's Bow. The Command Melody is learned inside.

items.name: Hyrule Castle
items.howTo: Ring the bell atop the tower to descend to Hyrule under the sea, solve the courtyard's statue puzzle and draw the Master Sword in the castle basement.
items.notes: Reached through the Tower of the Gods; Hyrule has no square of its own on the Sea Chart.

items.name: Forsaken Fortress (second visit)
items.howTo: Return with the Master Sword, get the Skull Hammer after Phantom Ganon and defeat the Helmaroc King at the top of the tower to rescue Aryll.
items.notes: Boss: Helmaroc King. Treasure: Skull Hammer. Ganondorf reveals that Tetra is Princess Zelda.

items.name: Earth Temple
items.howTo: Get the Power Bracelets in Fire Mountain, learn the Earth God's Lyric on Headstone Island, wake Medli on Dragon Roost Island and bring her to the temple. Defeat Jalhalla.
items.notes: Boss: Jalhalla. Treasure: Mirror Shield. Fire Mountain needs the Ice Arrows from the Queen of Fairies (Mother and Child Isles, via the Ballad of Gales).

items.name: Wind Temple
items.howTo: Get the Iron Boots on Ice Ring Isle, learn the Wind God's Aria on Gale Isle, wake Makar in Forest Haven and bring him to the temple. Defeat Molgera.
items.notes: Boss: Molgera. Treasure: Hookshot. Ice Ring Isle needs the Fire Arrows.

items.name: The Master Sword's power
items.howTo: With both sages awake, return to Hyrule Castle; the Master Sword's power is restored, and the King of Red Lions sends Link after the Triforce of Courage.

items.name: Triforce of Courage
items.howTo: With all eight Triforce Shards, return to the Tower of the Gods and dive into Hyrule; the Triforce of Courage is made whole.

items.name: Ganon's Tower
items.howTo: Break the barrier around Hyrule Castle and climb Ganon's Tower: refight the four dungeon bosses, find the Light Arrows in Phantom Ganon's maze and defeat Puppet Ganon.
items.notes: Bosses: Gohma, Kalle Demos, Jalhalla, Molgera, Phantom Ganon and Puppet Ganon.

items.name: Ganondorf
items.howTo: Defeat Ganondorf at the top of the tower, deflecting Zelda's Light Arrows with the Mirror Shield.

sections.title: Triforce Shards
sections.note: Find each Triforce Chart, have Tingle decipher it on Tingle Island, then salvage the shard.

items.name: Triforce Shard 1
items.howTo: Salvage it at Greatfish Isle (D2) once Tingle has deciphered Triforce Chart 1. The chart: Sink the warship blocking the islet's entrance, go in and conduct the Wind's Requiem on the Wind Waker symbol.
items.notes: Triforce Chart 1 is found at Islet of Steel (see Charts); Tingle deciphers it for 398 Rupees. The King of Red Lions sends Link after the shards once the Master Sword's power is restored. Also needed in Wind Waker HD, where it is chart 1 of 3.

items.name: Triforce Shard 2
items.howTo: Salvage it at Gale Isle (A4) once Tingle has deciphered Triforce Chart 2. The chart: Get the Cabana Deed from Mrs. Marie (20 Joy Pendants), then in Mrs. Marie's Cabana pull the lever above the fireplace with the Grappling Hook and crawl through the maze under the chimney.
items.notes: Triforce Chart 2 is found at Private Oasis (see Charts); Tingle deciphers it for 398 Rupees. The King of Red Lions sends Link after the shards once the Master Sword's power is restored. In Wind Waker HD only Triforce Charts 1, 3 and 5 remain (renumbered 1 to 3); the other five shards wait where their charts were, so this shard is in that chest instead.

items.name: Triforce Shard 3
items.howTo: Salvage it at Stone Watcher Island (E3) once Tingle has deciphered Triforce Chart 3. The chart: Feed a Hyoi Pear to a seagull and fly it into the switches in the Kargarocs' nests to open the way in.
items.notes: Triforce Chart 3 is found at Bird's Peak Rock (see Charts); Tingle deciphers it for 398 Rupees. The King of Red Lions sends Link after the shards once the Master Sword's power is restored. Also needed in Wind Waker HD, where it is chart 2 of 3.

items.name: Triforce Shard 4
items.howTo: Salvage it at Outset Island (G2) once Tingle has deciphered Triforce Chart 4. The chart: Get the Ghost Ship Chart from Diamond Steppe Island, find the ship at night where the chart shows it for that moon phase, and defeat the enemies inside.
items.notes: Triforce Chart 4 is found at Ghost Ship (see Charts); Tingle deciphers it for 398 Rupees. The King of Red Lions sends Link after the shards once the Master Sword's power is restored. In Wind Waker HD only Triforce Charts 1, 3 and 5 remain (renumbered 1 to 3); the other five shards wait where their charts were, so this shard is in that chest instead.

items.name: Triforce Shard 5
items.howTo: Salvage it at Cliff Plateau Isles (F7) once Tingle has deciphered Triforce Chart 5. The chart: Sink the golden warship by the island with the cannon and salvage what it leaves.
items.notes: Triforce Chart 5 is found at Needle Rock Isle (see Charts); Tingle deciphers it for 398 Rupees. The King of Red Lions sends Link after the shards once the Master Sword's power is restored. Also needed in Wind Waker HD, where it is chart 3 of 3.

items.name: Triforce Shard 6
items.howTo: Salvage it at Southern Triangle Island (E4) once Tingle has deciphered Triforce Chart 6. The chart: Clear floor 30 of the Savage Labyrinth (lift the stone head on the hill with the Power Bracelets) and conduct the Wind's Requiem on the symbol there.
items.notes: Triforce Chart 6 is found at Outset Island (see Charts); Tingle deciphers it for 398 Rupees. The King of Red Lions sends Link after the shards once the Master Sword's power is restored. In Wind Waker HD only Triforce Charts 1, 3 and 5 remain (renumbered 1 to 3); the other five shards wait where their charts were, so this shard is in that chest instead.

items.name: Triforce Shard 7
items.howTo: Salvage it at Seven-Star Isles (A6) once Tingle has deciphered Triforce Chart 7. The chart: Lift the stone head with the Power Bracelets and defeat the enemies in the cave below.
items.notes: Triforce Chart 7 is found at Stone Watcher Island (see Charts); Tingle deciphers it for 398 Rupees. The King of Red Lions sends Link after the shards once the Master Sword's power is restored. In Wind Waker HD only Triforce Charts 1, 3 and 5 remain (renumbered 1 to 3); the other five shards wait where their charts were, so this shard is in that chest instead.

items.name: Triforce Shard 8
items.howTo: Salvage it at Two-Eye Reef (G4) once Tingle has deciphered Triforce Chart 8. The chart: Hookshot up to the island and defeat the enemies in its secret cave.
items.notes: Triforce Chart 8 is found at Overlook Island (see Charts); Tingle deciphers it for 398 Rupees. The King of Red Lions sends Link after the shards once the Master Sword's power is restored. In Wind Waker HD only Triforce Charts 1, 3 and 5 remain (renumbered 1 to 3); the other five shards wait where their charts were, so this shard is in that chest instead.
